firms with less market share enjoy greater returns on their IT investment when their markets are more attractive.
firms with lower market power benefit more from information technology in growing industries than firms with higher market power.
the economic value of information technology to firms is greater for firms that are in growing markets and that have less market power.

the value of information technology to firms, and how the economic benefits of information technology are influenced by industry growth.

the impact of IT on firm performance depends on industry and firm attributes.
